name: Mini Museum
summary:
Mini Museum delivers a rich, bite‑sized VR museum experience. It features nine exhibits—three dinosaurs, three real animals, and three entirely fictional creatures. For the dinosaurs and real animals, each display includes an embedded link to its Wikipedia page, so users can dive deeper when online.

A play‑button icon appears to the left of every exhibit; tapping it zooms in the model for close‑up viewing. Using the middle‑finger trigger on a Meta controller, you can grab any exhibit to move and rotate it
